title: One Program per Customer: SafeStep Safety Footwear & Eyewear Program
content:
# Customer Care Guidance Note — One SafeStep Program per Customer

**Rule.** A customer holds at most one SafeStep program covering all of its participating employees across its sites. A program is not enrolled while the customer has a program whose status is enrolled, active or suspended.

The limit is 1 SafeStep Safety Footwear & Eyewear Program per customer. That one program covers every participating employee of the customer, whatever site the employee works at; sites do not hold programs of their own.

## What the records must show

Whether a new program may be enrolled is decided from the company's own program records for that customer, as they stand before the enrollment, not from the caller's description. The test is whether any SafeStep program of the same customer currently has the status enrolled, active or suspended.

| Status of the customer's existing SafeStep program | New SafeStep program enrolled? |
|---|---|
| Enrolled (not yet live) | No |
| Active | No |
| Suspended | No |
| Closed | Not barred by this rule |
| No program on record | Not barred by this rule |

## Points of judgement

- A suspended program still counts: while the customer's program is suspended, no second program is enrolled.
- A program that has been closed does not count toward the limit.
- Participating employees at any further site of the customer are covered under the customer's one program, since that program covers participating employees across all of its sites.
